content: Nai ulun sarani sira halibur hamutuk iha Jerusalém
Iha tempu nebaa ema sarani balu mai husi Judeia too iha Antiokia. Sira hanorin sarani sira dehan, “Se imi hakarak hetan salvasaun, imi tenki sunat tuir lisan nebee Moisés rai hela ba ita.”

Maibee Paulo ho Barnabé haksesuk malu makaas ho sira. Tanba sira kontra malu nunee, sarani sira desidi para haruka Paulo ho Barnabé ho mos sarani balu husi Antiokia lori problema nee ba apostolu sira ho responsavel sira iha Jerusalém.

Entaun sarani sira iha Antiokia haruka delegasaun nee baa. Sira lao liu husi provinsia Fenísia ho Samaria, i sira konta ba sarani sira iha nebaa katak, ema nebee laos Judeu mos fiar ona ba Jesus. Rona nunee sarani sira haksolok.
Bainhira sira too iha Jerusalém, apostolu sira ho responsavel sira ho mos sarani sira tomak simu sira ho diak. Paulo ho Barnabé foo hatene buat hotu nebee Maromak halo ona liu husi sira.
Maibee sarani Judeu balu husi grupu Farizeu hamriik hodi dehan, “Se ema nebee laos Judeu hakarak tuir Jesus, entaun sira tenki sunat ho mos tuir lei seluk nebee Maromak foo liu husi Moisés.”
Entaun apostolu sira ho responsavel sira halibur hamutuk hodi rezolve problema ida nee.

Sira diskuti ba-mai. Too ikus, Pedro hamriik hodi dehan, “Maun-alin sira, imi hatene katak, uluk Maromak hili hau husi imi atu lori Liafuan Diak ba ema sira nebee laos Judeu, atu sira mos bele fiar ba Jesus.
Maromak hatene ita ida-idak nia laran. Nia mak foo Espiritu Santu ba sira, hanesan uluk Nia foo ba ita. Ho nunee Maromak hatudu mai ita katak Nia simu sira.
Nia haree sira ho ita hanesan. Nia hamoos ona sira nia laran tanba sira fiar ba Jesus, hanesan mos Nia hamoos ona ita nia laran.

Entaun nusaa mak imi koko Maromak hodi foo todan ba sarani sira nebee laos Judeu nee?! Ita ho ita nia bei-ala sira nunka bele halo tuir Moisés nia lei tomak. Agora imi hakarak obriga fali sira halo tuir buat sira nee hotu ka?
La bele! Tanba ita fiar katak, liu husi ita nia Nai Jesus nia laran diak mak ita ema Judeu hetan salvasaun. Ema nebee laos Judeu mos nunee.”
Hotu tiha Barnabé ho Paulo konta milagre ho sinal oi-oin nebee Maromak halo liu husi sira iha ema laos Judeu nia leet. Ema nebee tuir enkontru nee nonook hodi rona.
Bainhira sira nain rua koalia hotu, Tiago dehan, “Maun-alin sira, imi rona hau lai!
Simão Pedro
konta ona mai ita kona ba tempu nebee Maromak fo-foun hatudu Nia domin ba ema nebee laos Judeu hodi foti sira sai Nia povu.
Nee hanesan ho buat nebee Maromak foo sai liu husi Nia profeta sira nunee:

content.text: Maibee too tempu ida, Hau sei fila fali mai
hodi harii fila fali nia ukun,
Nunee ema husi nasaun sel-seluk bele mai buka Hau nudar sira nia Nai.
Jentiu sira nebee Hau bolu tiha ona sai Hau nia povu, sei mai hotu.
Hau foo hatene tiha ona buat sira nee hori uluk kedas.’ ”

content: Tiago hatutan tan dehan, “Nee duni tuir hau nia hanoin, ita keta foo todan ba ema laos Judeu nebee desidi atu tuir Maromak.

Ita tenki hakerek karta ida ba sira, para foo hatene dehan sira la presiza tuir ita nia lei hotu. Ita foo hanoin deit ba sira dehan, sira la bele haan naan nebee mak hamulak tiha ona ba lulik. Sira la bele halo sala seksual. Sira la bele haan animal nia raan. I la bele haan naan husi animal nebee la koa kakorok hodi hasai nia raan.
Buat sira nee laos foun ba sira. Tanba hori uluk too agora, Sabadu-Sabadu ema lee sai Moisés nia lei iha uma kreda Judeu nian hotu-hotu, i ema esplika lei nee iha aldeia ida-ida.”
Nai ulun sarani sira haruka karta ba sarani sira nebee laos Judeu

Depois apostolu sira ho responsavel sira ho sarani sira hotu iha Jerusalém konkorda atu haruka ema baa foo hatene kona ba sira nia desizaun ba sarani sira iha sidade Antiokia. Sira hili ema nain rua nebee sarani sira respeita. Ida naran Judas, ema mos bolu Barsabás. Ida seluk naran Silas. Sira haruka ema nain rua nee baa hamutuk ho Paulo ho Barnabé.

Sira lori karta ida hakerek nunee: “Ba ami nia maluk sarani nebee laos Judeu iha sidade Antiokia, iha provinsia Síria tomak, ho mos provinsia Silísia. Kumprimentus husi ami apostolu ho responsavel sira iha Jerusalém.
Ami rona dehan, iha ema balu husi Jerusalém baa hanorin imi la loos, halo imi nia laran susar ho laran ru-rua kona ba salvasaun. Ema sira nee, laos ami mak haruka baa.

Entaun ami hotu laran ida desidi haruka ema balu ba imi atu hatoo rasik saida mak hakerek iha karta laran nee. Ami hili Judas ho Silas. Sira sei baa hamutuk ho ita nia maluk doben Barnabé ho Paulo. Barnabé ho Paulo nee foo aan ba mate tanba tuir ita nia Nai Jesus Kristu.
Espiritu Santu foo hatene ona ba ami, i ami mos konkorda atu la bele foo todan ba imi hodi obriga imi tuir lei Judeu nian tomak. Iha deit lei balu mak imi presiza halo tuir mak nee:

content.text: La bele haan naan nebee mak hamulak tiha ona ba lulik.
La bele haan animal nia raan.
La bele haan naan husi animal nebee la koa kakorok hodi hasai nia raan.

content: Se imi halo tuir buat hirak nee, diak ona. Mak nee deit. Adeus.”
Sira nain haat simu tiha karta nee, sira lori ba sidade Antiokia. Too iha nebaa, sira halibur sarani sira hotu hodi entrega karta nee ba sira.
Bainhira sarani sira lee tiha surat nee, sira haksolok, tanba liafuan nee hametin sira nia laran.
Judas ho Silas mos profeta, i sira koalia buat barak ba sarani sira hodi hametin sira nia laran i halo sira nia fiar sai forti.
Sira hela laduun kleur. Depois sira fila fali ba Jerusalém, lori kumprimentus husi sarani sira iha Antiokia ba sarani sira nebee mak haruka sira mai nee.
[Maibee Silas desidi hela nafatin iha nebaa.]
Maibee Paulo ho Barnabé hela iha Antiokia. Hamutuk ho ema barak tan, sira nain rua hanorin ho foo sai Maromak nia liafuan kona ba Nai Jesus.
Paulo ho Barnabé fahe malu
Too loron ida Paulo hatete ba Barnabé, “Mai ita fila fali baa vizita fatin sira nebee uluk ita foo sai Nai Maromak nia liafuan. Ita baa haree took sarani sira nia moris oinsaa.”
Barnabé konkorda. Nia hakarak lori João baa hamutuk ho sira, João nee ema mos bolu Marcos.
Maibee Paulo lakohi lori nia, tanba uluk Marcos servisu hamutuk ho sira la too rohan, nia husik hela sira iha provinsia Panfília.
Paulo ho Barnabé diskuti malu makaas, too sira nain rua fahe malu. Barnabé lori Marcos baa sae roo hodi baa tiha rai Xipre.
Maibee Paulo hili Silas atu lao hamutuk ho nia. Sarani sira iha nebaa halo orasaun ba sira hodi entrega sira ba iha Nai Maromak nia liman. Depois sira nain rua baa ona.
Sira lao lemo-lemo iha provinsia Síria ho Silísia hodi hametin sarani sira nia laran.

footnotes.text: Iha nee Lucas hakerek “Simão”. Nee Pedro nia naran seluk.
Kopia livru nee husi tempu antigu barak. Versikulu 34 nee tama iha kopia balu, maibee iha kopia barak la tama.
